summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 14,175,827 common shares for gross proceeds of about $152.9 million, priced at net asset value per share as of August 31, 2026. The shares were sold under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S exemptions. The board also declared monthly distributions of $0.0625 per share across classes, net of servicing fees, payable October 19 to holders of record September 30. This is a routine capital-raising and distribution notice, not a special situation. No deal premium, advisor, or closing conditions stated.
